about: CBZ Risk Advisory Services supports the Group and its clients with enterprise-wide risk management and tailored advisory: short-term insurance broking, risk assessment with control measures and captive management, independent claims assessment, employee benefits and pensions consulting, healthcare consulting and individual financial planning. Botswana Reinsurance Brokers, wholly owned, extends the broking reach regionally.
productsNote: Broking and advisory services are governed by IPEC regulations. Terms, premium rates and coverage extensions are negotiated across licensed underwriters based on risk profiling.
